_about: Scope text for every case policy key (D36). Each text says WHO the rule binds and WHICH EVENT it governs, plus units. It never says how a case should be decided. scripts/apply_case_rule_texts.py writes these into the case files as {value, text}.
abuse_zero_tolerance: Governs abusive language or behaviour by a driver or rider toward the other party during a trip. A true value means a confirmed incident is not treated as a first minor offence.
accepted_sources: Lists the kinds of record this trip's policy accepts as evidence for the disputed charge or event. It governs which records count, not what they show.
allowed_evidence: Lists the kinds of record this trip's policy accepts as evidence for the disputed charge or event. It governs which records count, not what they show.
amounts_above_cap_not_chargeable_to_ride: Governs any fee charged to the rider that has a stated maximum in this trip's policy. A true value means the part of a charge above that maximum may not be billed to the rider.
arrival_evidence: Names the record that counts as proof that the driver arrived at the pickup point. It governs how arrival is established, not whether a fee is due.
arrival_wait_fee_threshold_min: Minutes the driver must wait after arriving at the pickup point before a waiting or no-show fee can apply to the rider.
cancellation_fee_after_driver_assigned: The cancellation fee in SGD for a rider who cancels after a driver has been assigned and outside any free window. It governs rider cancellations only.
cancellation_fee_after_wait: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.
cancellation_fee_amount: The cancellation fee in SGD that this trip's policy allows to be charged to the rider when a fee is due.
cancellation_fee_sgd: The cancellation fee in SGD that this trip's policy allows to be charged to the rider when a fee is due.
cancellation_rating_applies_to: Names which party's cancellation record or rating is affected by a cancellation on this trip.
carpool_erp_split_percent: On a shared (pool) trip, the percentage of an ERP toll charged to each rider. It governs ERP on shared trips only.
claim_submission_window_hours: Hours after the trip within which a claim covered by this policy must be submitted. It governs when the claim was filed, not its merits.
classification_rule: States how this trip's policy classifies the event in dispute. It governs which category the event falls into, not the amount owed.
cleaning_claim_evidence_required: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.
cleaning_claim_photo_within_min_of_trip_: Minutes after the trip ends within which the driver's photo of the mess must be taken for a cleaning fee claim against the rider.
cleaning_fee_max: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.
cleaning_fee_max_sgd: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.
cleaning_fee_photo_required: Governs a driver's cleaning fee claim against a rider. A true value means the claim needs photo evidence of the mess.
cleaning_fee_receipt_required: Governs a driver's cleaning fee claim against a rider. A true value means the claim needs a receipt for the cleaning cost.
cleaning_fee_reversed_if_photo_late_or_m: Governs a cleaning fee already charged to a rider. A true value means the fee is reversed when the driver's photo is missing or taken outside the allowed time.
cleaning_fee_timeliness_hours: Hours after the trip within which a driver must submit a cleaning fee claim against the rider.
conduct_violation_first_action: The action taken against a driver for a first confirmed conduct violation. It governs driver conduct complaints only, not refunds.
contacting_passenger_after_trip_prohibit: Governs a driver contacting a rider after the trip has ended. A true value means such contact is not allowed outside official channels.
continuous_driver_presence_required: Governs a no-show or waiting fee claim against the rider. A true value means the driver must have stayed at the pickup point for the whole waiting period.
detour_billable_only_if: Governs extra distance driven away from the planned route on this trip. It lists the only conditions under which the rider may be billed for that extra distance.
detour_for_verified_road_closure_billabl: Governs extra distance caused by a road closure. A true value means the rider may be billed for it only when the closure is verified.
detour_not_agreed_by_rider_refundable: Governs a detour that the rider did not agree to. The value states which part of the fare is refunded to the rider in that situation.
deviation_evidence_required: Evidence needed to show why the driver left the planned route. It governs route deviation disputes.
deviation_reason_accepted: Lists the reasons for leaving the planned route that this trip's policy accepts from the driver.
driver_arrival_radius_m: Distance in metres from the pickup point within which the driver counts as arrived. It governs how arrival is measured for waiting and no-show fees.
driver_conduct_standard: The standard of behaviour expected of the driver toward riders. It governs driver conduct complaints.
driver_may_be_suspended_pending_investig: Governs serious safety or conduct reports against a driver. A true value means the driver's account may be suspended while the report is investigated.
driver_no_show_fee_sgd: The no-show fee in SGD, charged when the rider does not appear after the driver has waited past the no-show threshold.
driver_reason_documentation_required_for: Governs a driver who leaves the planned route. A true value means the driver must record a reason for doing so.
dropoff_change_requires_rider_confirmati: Governs a change of drop-off point during the trip. A true value means the change must be confirmed by the rider.
erp_charge_requires_active_gantry_crossi: Governs ERP toll charges on the rider's fare. A true value means a charge needs a crossing of a gantry that was active at that time.
erp_charge_requires_verifiable_gantry_ev: Governs ERP toll charges on the rider's fare. A true value means the gantry crossing must be shown by verifiable evidence such as GPS.
erp_handling: States how ERP tolls are treated in this trip's fare, for example whether they sit inside or outside the base fare.
erp_included_in_upfront_fare: Governs ERP tolls on an upfront-priced trip. The value says whether expected tolls are already inside the upfront fare.
evidence_for_cancellation_attribution: Evidence used to decide which party caused a cancellation. It governs who is responsible for the cancellation, not the fee amount.
evidence_for_waiting_time_fee: Evidence needed to support a waiting time fee charged to the rider.
evidence_required: Evidence this trip's policy requires before the disputed fee can stand against the rider.
evidence_required_for_cancellation_fee: Evidence needed to support a cancellation fee charged to the rider.
evidence_required_for_no_show_fee: Evidence needed to support a no-show fee charged to the rider.
evidence_required_for_waiting_fee: Evidence needed to support a waiting fee charged to the rider.
fare_basis: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.
fare_change_allowed_for_route_deviation: Governs a change to the rider's fare caused by a route deviation. The value says whether and when such a change is allowed.
fare_is_fixed_except_rydetaxi: Governs how fares are set by service type. A true value means every service except RydeTAXI has a fixed upfront fare.
fare_mode: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare.
fare_quote_locked_for_non_taxi_services: Governs the fare quote on non-taxi services. A true value means the quoted fare is locked once the rider confirms the booking.
fare_type: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare.
fee_cap_sgd: The maximum fee in SGD that may be charged to the rider under this trip's cancellation policy.
fee_caps_sgd: Maximum fees in SGD that may be charged to the rider, by fee type.
fee_conditional_on: Lists the conditions that must all hold before the disputed fee may be charged to the rider.
fee_goes_to: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.
free_cancellation_before_driver_assignme: Governs a rider who cancels before any driver has been assigned. A true value means no fee applies to that cancellation.
free_cancellation_window_min: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.
free_cancellation_window_minutes: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.
free_cancellation_within_min_of_match: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.
free_wait_minutes: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.
free_wait_minutes_after_arrival: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.
free_wait_time_min: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.
free_waiting_time_min: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.
free_window_inclusive: Governs the boundary of the free cancellation window. A true value means a cancellation at exactly the window's last minute is still free.
gps_gantry_proximity_meters: Distance in metres from an ERP gantry within which the GPS trace counts as passing that gantry.
gps_gap_review_threshold_min: Length in minutes of a gap in the GPS trace that makes the trace incomplete for the period it covers.
gps_speed_limit_kmh: Speed in km/h above which a GPS reading counts as speeding, for safety complaints about the driver.
grace_period_minutes: Minutes in the grace period that this trip's cancellation policy allows before a fee can apply to the rider.
idle_stop_requires_app_event_or_chat_con: Governs a stop in which the vehicle stays idle during the trip. It sets the length in minutes beyond which the stop needs an app event or the rider's agreement in chat.
location_conflict_condition: States when records of the driver's location count as conflicting. It governs how location evidence is weighed for waiting and no-show fees.
match_grace_period_min: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee.
match_to_first_cancel_free_min: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee.
metered_fallback_if_route_change_over_pe: Governs an upfront-priced trip whose route changes during the trip. It sets the percentage of route change above which the fare is recalculated as metered.
metered_fare_variation_normal_range_perc: Governs metered fares. It sets the percentage by which the final metered fare may normally differ from the estimate.
no_fee_if_driver_delayed_beyond_eta_min: Governs a rider who cancels while the driver is late. It sets the minutes past the driver's shown arrival time after which the rider owes no cancellation fee.
no_show_fee: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider does not appear after the driver waits past the no-show threshold.
no_show_fee_requires_driver_waiting_at_c: Governs a no-show fee against the rider. A true value means the driver must have waited at the pickup point in force at that moment, including any change the rider made.
no_show_fee_sgd: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider does not appear after the driver waits past the no-show threshold.
no_show_threshold_inclusive: Governs the boundary of the no-show threshold. A true value means a wait of exactly the threshold already meets it.
no_show_threshold_min: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.
no_show_threshold_minutes: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.
no_show_wait_start_event: Names the app event from which the no-show waiting time is counted.
no_show_wait_threshold_minutes: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.
p0_response: The response required for a P0 (most serious, safety-critical) report. It governs how the case is handled, not refunds.
p1_first_action: The first action taken against a driver for a confirmed P1 (serious but not safety-critical) report.
p1_incident_review_within_hours: Hours within which a P1 (serious but not safety-critical) report must be reviewed.
pickup_point_change_before_driver_arriva: Governs a rider who changes the pickup point in the app before the driver arrives. A true value means the driver must go to the new point.
policy_source: Says where this trip's policy block comes from. It is a label, not a rule.
pool_pax_limit_strict: Governs the number of passengers on a shared (pool) booking. A true value means the booked passenger count may not be exceeded.
professional_cleaning_required: Governs a driver's cleaning fee claim against a rider. A true value means the fee must be for professional cleaning.
professional_cleaning_window_hours: Hours after the trip within which professional cleaning must be done for a cleaning fee claim against the rider.
promo_returns_on_cancellation: Governs a promo code used on a booking that is later cancelled. A true value means the promo is returned to the rider.
refund_at_ryde_discretion: Says Ryde staff may grant a goodwill refund, case by case, outside the other rules. It is a person's decision: it never makes a charge that this trip's other rules allow refundable, and it does not set any amount.
rider_agreement_withdrawn_before_the_det: Governs a rider who agreed to a detour and then withdrew that agreement before the detour began. A true value means the earlier agreement no longer counts.
rider_cancellation_grace_minutes: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee.
rider_compensation: States how compensation to the rider is decided for this type of complaint.
rider_may_dispute_if: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.
rider_route_requests_must_be_agreed_befo: Binds the rider. A route or stop that the rider asks for must be agreed with the driver before the trip starts. It does not govern route changes the driver makes.
route_change_measured_against: Says which route a change is measured against when computing the percentage of route change on this trip.
route_change_requires_rider_consent_befo: Governs a change to the planned route. A true value means the change needs the rider's consent before the trip starts.
route_deviation_check_tolerance_km: Extra distance in km beyond the planned route that is treated as normal variation, not a deviation.
route_deviation_review_threshold_km: Extra distance in km beyond the planned route above which the trip counts as deviated and is reviewed.
route_deviation_threshold_percent: Extra distance, as a percentage of the planned route, above which the trip counts as deviated.
route_distance_tolerance_km: Extra distance in km beyond the planned route that is treated as normal variation, not a deviation.
service_fee_max_percent_of_user_charges: The maximum service fee as a percentage of the rider's charges. It governs the platform's service fee, not the fare.
service_quality_evidence_requirements: Evidence needed to support a service quality complaint about the driver.
service_tier_sgd: Prices in SGD by service tier. It governs which tier's price applies to this trip.
service_type: The Ryde service booked for this trip, for example RydeX, RydePOOL or RydeTAXI. It is a fact about the trip, not a rule.
surge_display_required: Governs surge pricing. A true value means the surge must be shown to the rider before the booking is confirmed.
surge_display_requirement_before_confirm: Governs surge pricing. The value says whether the surge must be shown to the rider before the booking is confirmed.
surge_must_be_displayed_before_confirmat: Governs surge pricing. A true value means the surge must be shown to the rider before the booking is confirmed.
threshold_inclusive: Governs time thresholds in this cancellation policy. A true value means reaching exactly the threshold already meets it.
trip_mode: The type of booking, for example on-demand or scheduled. It is a fact about the trip, not a rule.
trip_type: The type of booking, for example on-demand or scheduled. It is a fact about the trip, not a rule.
typical_vomit_cleaning_range: The usual cost range in SGD for cleaning up vomit. It governs whether a cleaning fee claimed against a rider is reasonable.
unbillable_detour_triggering_metered_fal: Governs a detour that cannot be billed but is large enough to trigger the metered fallback. The value states what the rider pays in that case.
unsubstantiated_erp_dispute_action: The action taken when a disputed ERP charge on the rider's fare cannot be shown either way from the records.
unverified_erp_allowance_sgd: The ERP amount in SGD that may be charged to the rider without verified gantry evidence.
updated_quote_must_be_accepted_before_fi: Governs a change of fare during the trip. A true value means the rider must accept the updated quote before it becomes the final fare.
upfront_fare_bound_to_confirmed_dropoff: Governs an upfront fare. A true value means the fare holds only for the drop-off point the rider confirmed.
upfront_fare_policy: States how upfront fares are treated on this trip, for example fixed once confirmed.
wait_clock_starts: Names the event from which waiting time at the pickup point is counted.
wait_count_from: Names the event from which waiting time at the pickup point is counted.
wait_timer_start: Names the event from which waiting time at the pickup point is counted.
waiting_fee_amount_sgd: The waiting fee in SGD charged to the rider when the driver waits past the free waiting time.
waiting_fee_min_wait_after_driver_arriva: Minutes the driver must wait after arriving before a waiting fee may apply to the rider.
waiting_fee_requires_trip_completed: Governs a waiting fee charged to the rider. A true value means the fee applies only when the trip then went ahead and was completed.
waiting_fee_sgd: The waiting fee in SGD charged to the rider when the driver waits past the free waiting time.
waiting_fee_threshold_inclusive: Governs the boundary of the waiting fee threshold. A true value means a wait of exactly the threshold already meets it.
waiting_fee_threshold_minutes: Minutes the driver must wait after arriving before a waiting fee may apply to the rider.
waiting_fee_wait_minutes_threshold: Minutes the driver must wait after arriving before a waiting fee may apply to the rider.
waiting_time_fee_requires_trip_completed: Governs a waiting fee charged to the rider. A true value means the fee applies only when the trip then went ahead and was completed.
waiting_time_fee_sgd: The waiting fee in SGD charged to the rider when the driver waits past the free waiting time.
zero_tolerance_unsafe_driving: Governs confirmed unsafe driving by the driver. A true value means it is not treated as a first minor offence.
